label: Every ground-closed collection of actual CONCRETE_6 with no actual root is empty
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: at the selected world w, no collection of actual concreta that contains every actual concrete ground of each of its members is both nonempty and without an actual root. In Lean: for every predicate S on candidates, if every member of S is an actual concretum at w, every actual concrete ground at w of a member of S is in S, and no member of S is an actual root (an actual concretum with no actual concrete ground at w), then nothing is in S. The weak version of STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF: it allows endless descending chains and cycles of grounds as long as a root grounds into them, and no asymmetry or uniform path-length bound is imposed. Under explicit excluded middle, CCR is equivalent to finite concrete-root access for every actual concretum.
